title: Physics-Informed Graph-Based Safe RL with Constraint-Specific Critics for Community Battery Coordination in Distribution Network
abstract: arXiv:2610.33654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High penetrations of distributed energy resources (DERs) and fast-varying electric vehicle (EV) charging intensify voltage and line-limit violations in distribution networks (DNs), making safe, low-cost operation increasingly challenging. This paper proposes a physics-informed safe deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for coordinating community battery energy storage systems to mitigate constraint violations while minimizing operating cost. To represent nonlocal spatiotemporal interactions, we develop a dual-level physics-informed graph representation in which line impedance and capacity shape spatial information propagation, while power-balance, voltage-profile, and flow-reconstruction losses regularize the latent state toward control-relevant physical consistency. translated_title: 基于物理信息图与约束专用评论家的安全强化学习在配电网社区电池协调中的应用
translated_abstract: 高渗透率的分布式能源（DER）接入与快速变化的电动汽车（EV）充电加剧了配电网中的电压越限和线路容量越限问题，使得安全、低成本的运行变得愈发困难。本文提出一种面向社区电池储能系统协调的物理信息安全深度强化学习（DRL）框架，旨在最小化运行成本的同时缓解约束越限问题。为表征非局部的时空交互作用，我们开发了一种双层物理信息图表示：其中线路阻抗与容量塑造空间信息的传播，而功率平衡、电压分布和潮流重构损失则将潜在状态正则化，使其保持与控制相关的物理一致性。基于该表示，我们提出了拉格朗日专用评论家PPO算法（LDCPPO），实现约束特定的价值分解：通过独立的奖励……
tldr: 本文提出一种融合双层物理信息图表示与约束专用评论家网络的拉格朗日PPO安全强化学习框架（LDCPPO），通过协调社区电池储能系统，在最小化运行成本的同时有效缓解配电网的电压与线路越限问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LDCPPO, a physics-informed graph-based safe deep RL framework with constraint-specific critics, which coordinates community battery energy storage systems to mitigate voltage and line-limit violations in distribution networks while minimizing operating costs.
